race.comment: ROSSANADO (12) was a fresh-up winner then just pipped behind Ansen Bay here last time. On the quick back-up and back up in trip but has a super consistent record here and will push forward from the tricky gate. At top and looks a leading chance again. ICHIBAN (8) was a narrow second here two back then a game fourth in the Cup. This easier and gets chance to atone. CROWN WATERS (7) set the pace but faded late when ninth here last week. Better draw and and likely to feature. AWASH (10) is well placed and gets his chance to break through. THE GIRL'S BOY(6) had been in super consistent form before a sixth in open class latest. Gets chance to atone.
